metadata.title: Autodesk Inventor Assembly Operations — Multi-Component Assembly Environment
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the Inventor Assembly environment (.iam) — the multi-part document type that aggregates parts and sub-assemblies via component placement, geometric constraints, kinematic joints, patterns, and adaptive features. Inventor maintains TWO parallel relation systems: (1) classical AssemblyConstraints (Mate / Angle / Tangent / Insert / Symmetry / Rotation) — DOF-by-DOF removal style, dating from R1; and (2) AssemblyJoints (Rigid / Rotational / Slider / Cylindrical / Planar / Ball) — origin-pair based, introduced in 2014 to mirror SolidWorks-style mate references. Joints are recommended for new designs; constraints remain supported and many existing assemblies mix both. Catalog covers 21 operations: 2 placement (Place Component, Place from Content Center), 3 pattern (Rectangular / Circular / Mirror), 6 constraint types, 6 joint types, Adaptivity (per-component flag enabling parts to morph based on assembly context), Frame Analysis (FEA bridge for frame-generator assemblies), BOM (assembly bill of materials), and Interference Analysis (collision detection). Bindings reference real ComponentDefinition COM API (Occurrences.Add / OccurrencePatterns / AssemblyConstraints / AssemblyJoints / BOM / AnalyzeInterference + FrameAnalysis manager).
metadata.source: Autodesk Inventor 2025 Help — Assembly Reference + Joints Reference; Inventor API Reference — Assembly namespace (AssemblyComponentDefinition, Occurrences, OccurrencePatterns.AddRectangularOccurrencePattern / AddCircularOccurrencePattern / AddMirrorOccurrencePattern, AssemblyConstraints.AddMateConstraint / AddAngleConstraint / AddTangentConstraint / AddInsertConstraint / AddSymmetryConstraint / AddRotationMotionConstraint, AssemblyJoints.Add with kRigidJointType / kRotationalJointType / kSliderJointType / kCylindricalJointType / kPlanarJointType / kBallJointType, BOM, AnalyzeInterference); FrameAnalysisManager for FEA on frame assemblies; Content Center API (ContentCenterFamilies.GetFamilyByDispName)

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across Inventor Assembly features. Constraint and joint ops use Selection / Solution / Limits tabs; placement uses Source / Position; patterns use Components / Pattern; analysis uses Setup / Output.

PLACE_COMPONENT.description: Insert a component (.ipt part or .iam sub-assembly) into the active assembly. Position controls placement strategy: free-place (drop at cursor), at-origin (align component origin to assembly origin), at-snap (snap to a face/edge/point). Grounded flag locks the component's position so it cannot move under solver — typically set on the first / base component. Quantity places multiple identical occurrences in one operation.

parameters.name: Quantity
parameters.description: Number of occurrences to place in one operation

parameters.name: Orientation Override
parameters.description: Override default orientation as 'X,Y,Z' Euler angles in degrees

parameters.name: Grounded
parameters.description: Lock component's position (cannot move under solver)

parameters.name: Auto-Constraint
parameters.description: Auto-detect and apply constraints to nearby geometry on place

parameters.name: Default Material Override
parameters.description: Material override for placed component (defaults to source's iProperties)

PLACE_FROM_CONTENT_CENTER.description: Insert a Content Center component (standard hardware: bolts, washers, nuts, bearings, etc.). Standard selects the dimensional convention; Family selects within the standard (e.g., 'ANSI Hex Bolt'); Family Member selects specific size. Material defaults from family but can override.

PATTERN_RECTANGULAR.description: Rectangular occurrence pattern — replicates one or more components along two directions. Spacing 1 / Count 1 control the first direction; Spacing 2 / Count 2 control the perpendicular direction (set Count 2 = 1 for a linear pattern).

parameters.name: Direction 1
parameters.description: Edge / axis / sketch line defining first direction

parameters.name: Count 1
parameters.description: Number of occurrences along Direction 1 (including original)

PATTERN_CIRCULAR.description: Circular occurrence pattern around an axis. Total Angle of 360 produces a closed ring; smaller angles produce arcs. Distribution selects spacing strategy: Equal (uniform angular spacing), Compute (set angle between adjacent items), Specify (explicit angle list). Skip Pattern allows omitting specific instances.

parameters.name: Skip Pattern
parameters.description: Comma-separated indices of instances to suppress (e.g., '2,5')

PATTERN_MIRROR.description: Mirror occurrence pattern across a plane. Reuse Components controls whether mirrored instances reference the same source files (true, recommended for symmetry) or generate flipped child files (false, required when symmetry breaks: e.g., asymmetric features). Status flags whether mirrored copies are active or initially suppressed.

parameters.name: Mirror Plane
parameters.description: Plane to mirror across (work-plane or planar face)

parameters.name: Reuse Components
parameters.description: Mirrored instances share source files (vs flipped child files)

CONSTRAINT_MATE.description: Mate / Flush constraint — the most common assembly constraint. Mate solution aligns face normals opposite (faces touch); Flush solution aligns face normals same direction (faces flush in plane). Mate-Tangent solution makes a face tangent to a cylindrical face. Mate-Insert combines axial alignment + planar mate (single constraint replaces 2 — used to seat fasteners into holes).

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Signed distance between mated faces (0 = touching)

parameters.name: Predict Offset Sign
parameters.description: Auto-flip offset sign if solver finds opposite-side fit

CONSTRAINT_ANGLE.description: Angle constraint between two faces / edges / axes. Solution selects how the angle is interpreted: Directed (signed; rotates from first to second), Undirected (unsigned; absolute), Explicit Reference Vector (uses an explicit reference for repeatable signed-angle behavior even when geometry rotates).

parameters.name: Predict Offset
parameters.description: Auto-pick solution sign that matches current pose

CONSTRAINT_TANGENT.description: Tangent constraint between a face and a cylindrical / spherical / conical face. Solution selects which side: Outside (faces touch externally — typical bearing-on-shaft) or Inside (one geometry inside the other — bearing-in-housing).

CONSTRAINT_INSERT.description: Insert constraint — combines axial-alignment + face-mate in one constraint. Removes 5 DOF (leaves rotation about the axis). Standard usage: seating a bolt into a hole — Pin Geometry is the bolt's shank axis, Hole Geometry is the hole's axis. Solution direction (Aligned / Opposed) controls which way the bolt's head ends up facing.

parameters.name: Pin Geometry
parameters.description: Cylindrical edge / axis of the inserted component (e.g., bolt shank)

parameters.name: Hole Geometry
parameters.description: Cylindrical edge / axis of the receiving feature (e.g., bolt hole)

parameters.name: Solution
parameters.description: Direction of the inserted component along the axis

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Axial offset along the insert axis (typical 0)

CONSTRAINT_SYMMETRY.description: Symmetry constraint — keeps two components symmetric across a plane. Component on one side mirrors the other across the symmetry plane in real-time as parameters change. Show Symmetry Plane visualizes the constraint plane in the assembly view.

parameters.name: Symmetry Plane
parameters.description: Plane the symmetry is enforced across

parameters.name: Component Override
parameters.description: Apply symmetry to whole component vs single geometry

parameters.name: Show Symmetry Plane
parameters.description: Visualize the symmetry plane in assembly

CONSTRAINT_ROTATION.description: Rotation / Rotation-Translation motion constraint. Type=Rotation gears two rotating components (e.g., gear pair) by a ratio; Type=Rotation-Translation links a rotating component to a translating component (e.g., rack-and-pinion). Driving flag selects which side is the driving body (other follows).

parameters.name: Ratio
parameters.description: Motion ratio (gear ratio for rotation, mm-per-rev for rotation_translation)

JOINT_RIGID.description: Rigid joint — locks two component origins together with all 6 DOF removed. Equivalent to grounding one component to another. Used as a base joint when components must move together (e.g., welded sub-assemblies represented as separate parts).

parameters.name: First Origin
parameters.description: Origin point on first component (face / edge midpoint / vertex / work-point)

parameters.name: Lock Position
parameters.description: Snap origins exactly together (vs preserving current offset)

parameters.name: Show Origin Triads
parameters.description: Display triad markers at each origin

JOINT_ROTATIONAL.description: Rotational joint — single rotational DOF about an axis (1 DOF active, 5 removed). Used for hinges, rotating shafts, pin joints. Limits Min/Max optionally bound the rotation angle (e.g., a hinge that opens 0..120 deg). Damping adds simulated rotational damping for dynamic-simulation studies.

parameters.name: Axis Reference
parameters.description: Rotation axis (defaults to Z of origin if omitted)

JOINT_SLIDER.description: Slider joint — single linear DOF along an axis (1 DOF active, 5 removed). Used for telescoping members, drawer slides, hydraulic cylinder rods. Linear limits bound the translation (e.g., 0..50 mm stroke). Friction parameter is for dynamic simulation only.

parameters.name: Friction
parameters.description: Coefficient of friction (0..1, for dynamic simulation)

JOINT_CYLINDRICAL.description: Cylindrical joint — combined rotation + translation about/along the same axis (2 DOF active, 4 removed). Used for sleeve bearings, lead screws (rotation + translation coupled in real-world but free in cylindrical joint), telescoping rotating shafts.

JOINT_PLANAR.description: Planar joint — translation in 2D plane + rotation about the plane normal (3 DOF active, 3 removed). Used for components sliding on a surface (puck on table, hovercraft on ground).

parameters.name: X-Limits
parameters.description: Min,Max in mm along plane X-axis

parameters.name: Y-Limits
parameters.description: Min,Max in mm along plane Y-axis

JOINT_BALL.description: Ball joint — 3 rotational DOF about a center point, 0 translational (3 DOF active, 3 removed). Used for spherical bearings, ball-and-socket joints, gimbals. Pitch / Yaw limits bound the rotation cone (typical 0..30 deg for a real ball joint).

parameters.name: Center Override
parameters.description: Optional explicit ball center (defaults to origin midpoint)

ADAPTIVITY.description: Per-component adaptivity flag. When enabled, an adaptive part can morph its geometry based on the assembly context — e.g., a sketch-driven extrude depth adapts to fit between mating parts. Geometry / Sketch / Feature flags control which subsystems participate in the adaptation.

parameters.name: Adaptive Features Enabled
parameters.description: Master enable for adaptivity on this component

parameters.name: Geometry Adaptive
parameters.description: Allow geometry projections / extrude-to-face to adapt

parameters.name: Feature Adaptive
parameters.description: Allow individual features (extrude depth, etc.) to adapt

FRAME_ANALYSIS.description: Frame Analysis — beam-element FEA on a frame-generator assembly (or any assembly of slender members). Computes static or modal response. Loads / Constraints accept JSON arrays of {location, force/moment/displacement}. Beam Element Order selects polynomial degree (linear / quadratic). Convergence tolerance bounds residual at solver termination.

parameters.name: Loads JSON
parameters.description: JSON array of load objects: [{location, type:force|moment|pressure, magnitude, direction}]

parameters.name: Constraints JSON
parameters.description: JSON array of constraint objects: [{location, type:fixed|pinned|roller, dof_lock}]

parameters.name: Material Override
parameters.description: Override frame member material for analysis (defaults per-member)

BILL_OF_MATERIALS.description: Assembly Bill of Materials. View Type selects depth: Structured (full sub-assembly hierarchy), Parts Only (flat leaf parts), Compact (top-level only with QPA — Quantity Per Assembly). Standard Hardware Treatment controls BOM behavior for Content Center parts: Promote (treat as normal items), Aggregate (single line with QTY), Hide (omit from BOM). Sub-Assembly Roll-Up rolls sub-assemblies into single rows or expands them as separate sections.

parameters.name: Sub-Assembly Roll-Up
parameters.description: Roll sub-assembly up as single line (vs expand)

INTERFERENCE_ANALYSIS.description: Interference (collision) detection between component pairs. Detection Mode selects which pairs are checked: All-vs-All (every component pair, expensive on large assemblies), Selected-vs-All (one selection vs everything else), Selected-vs-Selected (specific pair list). Contact Threshold defines the minimum interference volume to report (filters out tiny numerical noise). Excluded Pairs lists known-good interferences (e.g., bolt-thread engagement) to skip.

parameters.name: Components
parameters.description: Components to analyze (semantics depend on Detection Mode)

parameters.name: Surface Hatch
parameters.description: Display interference volumes as hatched bodies in view
